intent: A non-modal, rail-anchored inspector dialog that renders a generated control manifest (a title plus typed controls: number, color, text, boolean, enum, asset) as labelled rows.
guidance: Prefer the inline GeneratedControlsSection for ordinary generated properties — the spec's property-first pattern keeps values beside the rest of the selection. Reach for this dialog only when a focused host needs the manifest as a temporary surface. It is non-modal: focus is not trapped, and it anchors to the inspector surface's left edge (COMPOSA_INSPECTOR_SURFACE_SELECTOR) so it lands clear of the rail whatever the trigger's position. Controls render in manifest order; readOnly disables every field, and the animation diamond appears only where a binding is animatable and is suppressed when disabled. The dialog owns no value store — it projects native document state, so committing a field emits onChange(controlId, value).

anatomy.description: The 240px (COMPACT_INSPECTOR_DIALOG_WIDTH) anchored overlay, portalled above the canvas, docked beside the inspector rail; draggable by its header.
A 40px title bar with a bottom border, holding the title and the close affordance.
An <h2> rendering value.title in body-medium-strong; also the overlay's aria-label.
A 24px icon button labelled `Close {title}` that fires onClose.
A padded vertical stack of one ControlRow per manifest control, in manifest order.
A fixed 88px leading text label plus the flex-filled bound field; control.description is exposed via the row's title tooltip.
The kind-specific primitive: NumericInput, ColorInput, InputField, Switch, Dropdown+radio Menu, or a Choose-asset Button.

use_when: A focused host needs a generated control manifest as a temporary, dismissible surface anchored beside the inspector rail.
A control kit that must stay clear of scroll content and out of the way of the rail while editing.
dont_use_when: Ordinary generated properties — render them inline with GeneratedControlsSection in the Properties inspector section (property-first pattern).
A blocking confirmation — use a modal Dialog/Modal.
A single native field that already has a section (Fill, Stroke, Typography) — bind it there, not in a second surface.

slots.trigger: The ReactElement the dialog anchors to and launches from (captured in a trigger host span).

states: keyframe active (animation diamond, on animatable number/color controls)

Surface.note: From InspectorDialog/AnchoredInspectorOverlay default surface: rounded-c-lg bg-c-bg with var(--elevation-400) (elevation prop) over shadow-c-500.

tokens.note: No hex literals — colors, type, radius, and shadow are all token-bound. Layout dimensions are hardcoded px, not tokens: 240 width (COMPACT_INSPECTOR_DIALOG_WIDTH), 40 header height, 88 label column, 12 body/header insets, 8/4 row and stack gaps, 24 close button, 32 min row height.

a11y.role: dialog (non-modal) — rendered by the anchored inspector overlay (PopoverPrimitive.Content role="dialog", aria-modal=false), labelled by value.title. Focus is not trapped; Escape and outside interaction dismiss.
a11y.title: <h2> holds value.title; the overlay's aria-label mirrors it.
a11y.rows: number/color/enum fields take an ariaLabel from control.label and the Switch takes a label; control.description is surfaced via the row's title attribute; the enum menu uses radio MenuRows.

code.example: <GeneratedControlsDialog open={open} onClose={close} trigger={<Button label="Edit" />} value={{ id: 'glow', title: 'Glow', controls: [{ id: 'radius', kind: 'number', label: 'Radius', value: 8, unit: 'px' }, { id: 'tint', kind: 'color', label: 'Tint', value: tint }] }} onChange={(id, v) => patch(id, v)} />
